featured_reviews.name: Dr.R M Mukhopadhyay
featured_reviews.review_text:
All together it was a nice experience. Car was good, well maintained, clean. Driver was very nice & cordial in behaviour.Car reached my place in scheduled time. The driver also guided us nicely for the places to visit & also took us to nice restaurant to take our breakfast and lunch.
Now I want to draw your attention regarding some suggestions so that if you feel this is good then you can implement for betterment of your buisness & good will.
I was going for the first time to Lonavala+ Khandala for one day return trip from from Powai. As you are aware that the distance altogether is about 150 km for to & fro journey. We came back by 4 pm ( starting time was 8 AM from Powai). Your booking was for 300 km or upto 11.30 pm which ever is less.  When I requested driver that we have some more time to spend as per schedule, so, can we visit some more places in Mumbai with in scheduled time & km for which we have paid, he simply refused by putting logic that this trip is only for Khandala & Lonavala. Now my simple inquisitive approach to you that when you know the up & down distance altogether is around 150 km, why you have not guided us for lower km coverage? Moreover, when we wanted to get some more places to visit in Mumbai within scheduled time & milage for which we have paid, it was denied. This creates a feeling of being cheated on the part of the customer. May be my words are little harsh but be in my position & think empathetically & consider what you would have done if this would have  happened to you. I think you will take this feedback positively to generate more goodwill. "ONE SATISFIED CUSTOMER BRINGS 10 MORE CUSTOMERS IN FUTURE" - An old saying !

The Pushkar Camel Fair 2025 is one of India’s most vibrant cultural events, held in the holy town of Pushkar, Rajasthan. This annual mela blends camel trading with folk music, desert sports, and spiritual rituals at Pushkar Lake, offering visitors a unique experience of Rajasthan’s desert culture.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked an outstation cab for the Mumbai – Trimbakeshwar – Shirdi – Mumbai route. Overall, the experience was satisfactory, with a few areas where the service can improve.

Positives:

The driver arrived exactly at the requested pickup time.

The cab was clean and in good condition.

The rates were reasonable compared to other available options.

Areas for Improvement:

The cab should ideally be fully fueled (CNG and petrol) before the trip begins. Starting a long-distance journey without adequate fuel planning caused unnecessary delays.

The planned route is approximately 540 km according to maps, but our trip ended at 618 km. A major reason appears to be the driver's need to frequently go off-route in search of CNG. We visited around 9–10 fuel stations during the journey, which added extra distance and travel time.

More importantly, some acknowledgment of these inconveniences from the management would have been appreciated. Instead, the concerns were largely defended rather than addressed.

The trip was comfortable overall, and the service was good. A little better trip planning and a more receptive approach to customer feedback would make the experience much smoother.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed and constructive review of your recent trip to Trimbakeshwar and Shirdi. We genuinely appreciate both your positive feedback and your insights on where we can improve.

We are glad to hear that our driver arrived on time, the cab was clean, and our rates met your expectations. However, we also take your concerns regarding the route planning and refueling very seriously.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and delays caused by the frequent stops for CNG. You are entirely correct—long-distance journeys require proactive fuel planning to ensure a seamless experience. We are currently reviewing our operational guidelines with our drivers to ensure vehicles are fully prepped before pickup, and to better plan refueling stops along major routes to minimize detours.

Most importantly, we apologize for how your initial feedback was handled by our management team. We pride ourselves on being customer-first, and your concerns should have been met with an open mind rather than defensiveness. Please rest assured that we are addressing this internally to ensure our team handles customer feedback with the receptivity and respect it deserves.

Thank you again for helping us improve our service. We hope to have the opportunity to provide you with a much smoother and seamless journey in the future.

I had a very good experience on cab booking from Shubh Travels. Had booked a Toyota Innova (SUV)  from them at the last moment because my old Booking got cancelled from another travel agency due to the car breakdown. Shubhangi Koli Ma'am provide a car and Driver details in promise times.

The driver named Sanket arrived on time with a Neat and Clean Suv at my exact location. Most cool and helpful Driver I ever seen in my life. I booked a cab from Mumbai to Raigad for a return trip. We enjoyed the whole trip without any problems.

Awesome experience with travel on time pick and awesome hospitality. I were travelling with the Family. All are happy while travelling.

Again thanks to Shubhangi Koli for your valuable help and support for Booking . Definitely recommended for Travelling. ❤︎

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable trip for our customers is our top priority, and we're thrilled to hear that we succeeded in providing you and your family with a memorable travel experience. Your kind words mean a lot to us, and we truly appreciate your recommendation.

We look forward to serving you again in the future and providing you with more fantastic journeys. If you ever need our services again, don't hesitate to reach out.

Safe travels and warm regards,
Shubh Travels
